command: python3 scripts/verify_staged.py start; repeated next --count 5; then finish. Exact invocations and compiler argv are in process_record.json and RESULTS.json.
mathematical_claim: An actual closed first-order sentence in the membership-only language, with a separately coded regular-uncountable initial-cardinal guard, has a Lean-checked ZFSet interpretation equivalent to the independently specified filter-extension and residual existence assertions. Every satisfying guard is an actual initial-cardinal code. Unguarded existence is true, but aleph0 and nonregular cardinals fail the guard, and infinite successors fail the guarded extension. Base-theory insertion is formalized without declaring a ZFC theory or assuming existence.
input_domain: Mathlib membership-only first-order syntax, the concrete ZFSet universe, universe-polymorphic cardinal parameters, exact set graphs and filters; inherited residual and integer algebra.
tested_surrogate: Fresh proof elaboration, exhaustive named theorem axiom audit, predecessor source equality, expected rejection controls. Mathematical universal conclusions derive from the proof terms, not from finite enumeration.

bounds.build_strategy: Clean serial targets in hash-pinned resumable batches

pass_means: Every compilation succeeds, every named theorem is audited, axiom dependencies satisfy the standard allowlist, input hashes are unchanged, predecessor theorem sources match, and false proof and placeholder controls are rejected for the expected reasons.
failure_means: No final PASS or claim that all proofs checked. Compiler, audit, integrity or resource failures must be reported separately.
non_claims: No proof or assumption of an uncountable compactness cardinal or new consistency strength.
No object-language derivation from ZFC or internal set-theoretic classification in every arbitrary model of ZFC.
The closed sentence and guard have exact semantic interpretations in concrete ZFSet, not a proof of their truth.
The generic theory-insertion and elementary-equivalence lemmas are logical facts, not forcing absoluteness or arbitrary-model cardinal absoluteness.
No relative consistency, independence or identification of the integer cokernel with Mathlib right-derived limits.
